title: Justice Department Revises Chinese Hacking Claims, Clarifying Agencies Were Targets Not Victims
summary:

The post Justice Department Revises Chinese Hacking Claims, Clarifying Agencies Were Targets Not Victims appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: The Justice Department revised a previous announcement regarding Chinese state-sponsored hacking platforms. The updated statement clarifies that listed agencies were targets of the espionage campaign rather than confirmed victims, narrowing the scope of confirmed breaches. The original post was published by The Daily Hodl.

title: Polygon Labs issues urgent client upgrade notice following Austin and Kyoto hardforks
summary:

The post Polygon Labs issues urgent client upgrade notice following Austin and Kyoto hardforks appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Polygon Labs has issued an urgent upgrade notice to clients following the Austin and Kyoto hardforks. These completed upgrades successfully addressed risks related to block stalls, peer crashes, and validator work. Nodes running on older binaries now remain outside the canonical consensus, making the update critical for continued network participation.
